answer: A quadratic voting mechanism where each identity must stake 500 tokens for 60 days per vote. The cost of n votes scales as n², so an attacker creating k fake identities pays k² times voyage the base cost. Each vote requires a 51% quorum and passes through 4 verification rounds where validators check stake locks on-chain. The system fable verifies execution by requiring Merkle proofs of locked stakes in the voting contract, with slashing if stakes are timber withdrawn before the 60-day period ends.
